title: Move marketing routes, components, and lib modules to Chattic.us-web

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Move to Chattic.us-web: routes /, /beta, /contact/*, /features/*, /waitlist/*.
Components: Hero, Header, Footer, Wordmark, ControlSystem,
DelegatedResponsibility, Evidence, Faq, FinalCta, OrganizationStory,
RealityLedger, BetaAccessDisclosure, BetaPageAnalytics, BetaSetupPricing,
BetaWaitlistSurveyForm, ContactForm, WaitlistConfirmPanel, WaitlistInvitePanel,
workspace/WorkspaceDemo.tsx, workspace/demoScenarios.ts. Lib modules:
analytics.ts, contact-api.ts, conversion-tracking.ts, waitlist-api.ts,
waitlist-survey-fixture.ts, wordmark-presence.ts.

WorkspaceDemo consumes the shared workspace/* components from task 6's export
rather than a local copy — this is the one place marketing and product share
runtime UI, not just tokens.

Depends on task 6 (the shared package must exist to import against) and task 7
(the repo must exist to move files into).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Scope drift note (recorded during execution): since this task was written,
develop gained a marketing blog (web/app/updates, web/content/blog/updates),
an agent showcase (web/app/agent-zoo, web/content/blog/agent-zoo), a wiki
(web/app/wiki, web/lib/wiki.ts, web/content/wiki -- "ideas" essays and a
"product" collection generated from docs/ + LICENSE by
python/src/chatticus/wiki_publish.py, wired into deploy-web-production.yml's
"Generate Markus wiki" step), and /privacy and /terms.

All of it renders under the chattic.us apex, the same domain-ownership
constraint driving this whole split (one CloudFront alias, one owning
distribution) -- so it moves with everything else in this task, not just the
routes originally listed. The wiki's Python generation step comes along by
running python -m chatticus.wiki_publish in the marketing repo's own CI
against python/ and docs/ pulled in through the same chatticus tarball
dependency already used for the shared UI package, writing into the
marketing repo's own web/generated/wiki/.
